scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/check-hosts.mjs
scripts.test:net: NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' cucumber-js --tags "(@smoke or @regression) and not @wip and not @expected"
scripts.test:smoke: NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' cucumber-js --tags "@smoke and not @wip and not @expected"
scripts.test:regression: NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' cucumber-js --tags "@regression and not @wip and not @expected"
scripts.test:core: NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' cucumber-js --tags "@core and not @wip and not @expected"
